sentences.structure: 主干：He was an empathetic leader。修饰：of a team of extraordinary people 为介词短语修饰 leader；who had been shunned, threatened and harmed by the world 为定语从句修饰 people，三个过去分词构成排比；for their differences 为原因状语，说明被排斥的理由。
sentences.analysis_zh: 这句话真正的主语其实是“the world”——三个被动动词把施害者放在 by 之后，读起来是对主流社会的控诉。“for their differences”放在句末，是英语里常见的“尾重”安排：把最关键的语义落在最后，同时与全文“包容”的主题呼应。

background.title: 从皇家莎士比亚剧团到好莱坞：英国演员的双轨传统
background.text_zh: 英国表演界长期存在舞台与银幕互通的传统。皇家莎士比亚剧团（Royal Shakespeare Company，RSC）以斯特拉特福为基地，是全球最具权威的莎剧演出团体之一；布里斯托老维克戏剧学校（Bristol Old Vic Theatre School）也是英国老牌戏剧院校，出了不少知名演员。许多英国演员先在剧院打磨多年，再进入影视，所以在英国语境里“莎剧功底”常被当作演技背书。文中写到麦克莱恩劝斯图尔特“别为银幕放弃戏剧”，正是这一圈子的典型玩笑——两人后来都因商业大片在全球走红，这句话因此显得格外反讽。

background.title: “Number One”与《星际迷航》的乌托邦设定
background.text_zh: “Number One”是《星际迷航》中舰长对大副（副舰长）的昵称，源自航海传统，指“一号人物/副手”，《下一代》里 Picard 对 Riker 的这句称呼已成粉丝梗。1966年开播的《星际迷航》以星际舰队（Starfleet）和进取号（USS Enterprise，文中 USS 指“合众国星舰”）为核心设定，描绘了一个种族、性别、物种平等的未来社会，这正是文章结尾强调“包容性乌托邦”的原因。《下一代》（1987—1994）是该系列第二部主要剧集，斯图尔特主演七季，此后又拍了四部院线电影。

title_en: Search More Than 500 Cases of U.S. Citizens Detained by Immigration Agents
excerpt_en: The post Search More Than 500 Cases of U.S. Citizens Detained by Immigration Agents appeared first on ProPublica.
body_en: ProPublica Experts have long warned that immigration dragnets will inevitably result not only in the erosion of rights for immigrants but also for citizens. Since the start of this Trump administration, we’ve watched those warnings come true.

So we have once again done what the government won’t: We have tallied and cataloged every case we can find of an immigration agent reportedly detaining a citizen during the current administration — more than 500 cases from Inauguration Day through Oct. 21, 2026.
Read our earlier reporting on U.S. citizens being detained.

We compiled our list by scouring social media, court records and local media, and we included an incident only if we could find at least two sources for it. We asked the Department of Homeland Security about each incident, and we searched for any federal criminal charges that were brought in relation to each incident. (DHS has repeatedly said it is not arresting U.S. citizens.)

Since the government itself does not track these cases, our list is almost certainly an undercount. Below, we’re showing you every case we found — the reality that the administration denies — along with the receipts. Read more about how we reported this project.
The post Search More Than 500 Cases of U.S. Citizens Detained by Immigration Agents appeared first on ProPublica.

enrich.title_zh: ProPublica 梳理 500 多起美国公民遭移民执法人员拘留的案例
enrich.summary_zh: ProPublica 指出，专家长期警告移民大规模抓捕行动终将同时侵蚀移民与美国公民的权利，而这一警告在特朗普本届任期内已然成真。该机构通过检索社交媒体、法庭记录与地方媒体，交叉核实至少两个信源，统计出从就职日到 2026 年 10 月 21 日期间 500 多起移民执法人员拘留美国公民的案例。由于政府本身不追踪这类案件，这一数字几乎肯定被低估。

paragraphs.en: ProPublica Experts have long warned that immigration dragnets will inevitably result not only in the erosion of rights for immigrants but also for citizens. Since the start of this Trump administration, we’ve watched those warnings come true.
paragraphs.zh: ProPublica 长期以来，专家们一直警告说，移民大规模抓捕行动不可避免地不仅会侵蚀移民的权利，也会侵蚀美国公民的权利。自特朗普本届政府上任以来，我们眼看着这些警告一一变成了现实。

paragraphs.en: So we have once again done what the government won’t: We have tallied and cataloged every case we can find of an immigration agent reportedly detaining a citizen during the current administration — more than 500 cases from Inauguration Day through Oct. 21, 2026.
paragraphs.zh: 于是，我们再一次做了政府不愿做的事：把本届政府任内我们所能找到的每一例移民执法人员据报拘留美国公民的案件都逐一统计、编目——从总统就职日到 2026 年 10 月 21 日，共 500 多例。

paragraphs.en: Read our earlier reporting on U.S. citizens being detained.
paragraphs.zh: 阅读我们此前关于美国公民被拘留的报道。

paragraphs.en: We compiled our list by scouring social media, court records and local media, and we included an incident only if we could find at least two sources for it. We asked the Department of Homeland Security about each incident, and we searched for any federal criminal charges that were brought in relation to each incident. (DHS has repeatedly said it is not arresting U.S. citizens.)
paragraphs.zh: 我们的清单是通过检索社交媒体、法庭记录和地方媒体汇编而成的，并且只有在至少找到两个信源的情况下，我们才会把一起事件列入其中。我们就每一起事件向国土安全部提出了询问，并查询了与每起事件相关的任何联邦刑事指控。（国土安全部已多次表示，该部门并未逮捕美国公民。）

paragraphs.en: Since the government itself does not track these cases, our list is almost certainly an undercount. Below, we’re showing you every case we found — the reality that the administration denies — along with the receipts. Read more about how we reported this project.
paragraphs.zh: 由于政府本身并不追踪这类案件，我们的清单几乎可以肯定少于实际数量。下面，我们列出我们找到的每一起案例——也就是本届政府所否认的那个现实——并附上证据。进一步了解我们是如何完成这项报道的。

paragraphs.en: The post Search More Than 500 Cases of U.S. Citizens Detained by Immigration Agents appeared first on ProPublica.
paragraphs.zh: 《检索 500 多起美国公民遭移民执法人员拘留案例》一文首发于 ProPublica。

vocab.meaning_zh: （警方或执法部门的）大规模搜捕行动、拉网式清查（本义为“拖网”）
vocab.example_en: The city launched a dragnet across the neighborhood after the shooting.
vocab.example_zh: 枪击事件发生后，该市在这个街区展开了大规模搜捕。

vocab.meaning_zh: （权利、价值等的）逐步削弱、侵蚀
vocab.example_en: Critics say the new law will lead to the erosion of press freedom.
vocab.example_zh: 批评者称，这项新法律将导致新闻自由受到侵蚀。

vocab.meaning_zh: 统计、清点（数量）；n. 计数、 tally
vocab.example_en: Officials are still tallying the votes from Tuesday's election.
vocab.example_zh: 官员们仍在统计周二选举的选票。

vocab.meaning_zh: （系统地）编目、分类记录（英式拼写为 catalogue）
vocab.example_en: The report catalogs every documented case of police misconduct.
vocab.example_zh: 这份报告把每一例有据可查的警察不当行为都编目记录在案。

vocab.meaning_zh: （彻底地）搜索、翻查
vocab.example_en: Researchers scoured archives for any mention of the family.
vocab.example_zh: 研究人员翻遍档案，寻找任何提到这个家族的记录。

vocab.meaning_zh: 统计偏低、漏计的数量
vocab.example_en: Advocates say the official figures are a serious undercount.
vocab.example_zh: 维权人士称，官方数字存在严重的漏计。

vocab.meaning_zh: （口语）证据、凭据（源自“收据”，社交媒体常用语，意为“拿得出证据”）
vocab.example_en: She brought the receipts: emails, screenshots and bank records.
vocab.example_zh: 她拿出了证据：邮件、截图和银行记录。

vocab.meaning_zh: 拘留、扣押（此处指移民执法中的短暂羁押）
vocab.example_en: He was detained at the airport for several hours.
vocab.example_zh: 他在机场被扣留了几个小时。

vocab.meaning_zh: （美国总统）就职日，即 1 月 20 日；本文用它作为新政府任期的起点
vocab.example_en: The order was signed hours after Inauguration Day.
vocab.example_zh: 这项行政令在就职日数小时后即被签署。

sentences.en: Experts have long warned that immigration dragnets will inevitably result not only in the erosion of rights for immigrants but also for citizens.
sentences.structure: 主干：Experts（主）have warned（谓）that…（宾语从句）。从句主干：immigration dragnets（主）will result（谓）in the erosion of rights（介词宾语）。修饰：not only … but also … 连接两个并列的介词短语 in the erosion of rights for immigrants 与 (in the erosion of rights) for citizens，后者承前省略。
sentences.analysis_zh: 这句话是全篇的论点句。用 not only … but also 把“移民的权利”和“公民的权利”并列，是修辞上的递进：读者原以为抓捕行动只伤害外来者，文章强调最终会波及本国公民。注意 but also 后面只是一个 for citizens，省略了前面的 in the erosion of rights，阅读时要自行补全，否则容易读不通。

sentences.en: We compiled our list by scouring social media, court records and local media, and we included an incident only if we could find at least two sources for it.
sentences.structure: 由 and 连接的两个并列分句。前一分句：We（主）compiled（谓）our list（宾），by scouring … 为方式状语。后一分句：we（主）included（谓）an incident（宾），only if … 引导条件状语从句，其中 for it 是 sources 的后置定语。
sentences.analysis_zh: 这是新闻调查报道里交代方法论的典型句式：先说做了什么（compiled），再用 by doing 说明怎么做的，最后用 only if 交代取舍标准。only if 是“只有在……才”，比 if 语气强得多，等于向读者承诺：证据不足的案例一律不收录。两个信源的门槛是调查报道中常见的交叉验证标准。

sentences.en: Since the government itself does not track these cases, our list is almost certainly an undercount.
sentences.structure: 主干：our list（主）is（系）an undercount（表）。Since 引导原因状语从句（此处表原因，意为“由于”），almost certainly 为程度状语修饰整个判断。
sentences.analysis_zh: 先用 Since 从句把责任推给政府——“不是我们没找全，是官方根本不统计”；再用 almost certainly 这种留有余地的副词，避免把话说死。这种“承认局限反而增强可信度”的写法，是数据类调查报道的常见策略：既说明了数据的保守性，也暗示真实数字只会更大。

background.title: ProPublica 是什么机构
background.text_zh: ProPublica 是一家美国非营利性调查新闻编辑部，2007 年成立，以长篇调查报道著称，多次获得普利策奖。它不设付费墙，稿件常被其他媒体免费转载，因此文中会出现“Read our earlier reporting”“Read more about how we reported this project”这类指向站内相关报道和“方法论说明”的链接句——这是 ProPublica 的固定做法：把采访方法、数据来源单独写成一篇说明，供读者核查。

background.title: 国土安全部与移民执法体系
background.text_zh: 美国国土安全部（Department of Homeland Security, DHS）是 2001 年“9·11”后组建的内阁级部门，下属的移民与海关执法局（ICE）和海关与边境保护局（CBP）负责境内移民执法与边境拘押。文中的“immigration agent”指的就是这类执法人员。历史上，大规模身份清查（如工作场所突击检查）常被批评会连带波及在场的美国公民和合法居民，这正是文中“dragnet（拉网）”一词所暗示的执法模式。

title_en: How porn became so extreme – and how it’s shaping the sex lives of young people
excerpt_en: Extreme pornography has become readily available on mainstream porn sites. Clare McGlynn explains what this is doing to the sex lives of young people.
body_en: A few years ago, the singer Billie Eilish opened up on the Howard Stern Show about how she began watching porn around age 11.
“I’m so angry that porn is so loved, and I’m so angry at myself for thinking that it was ok,” she said.

Eilish became addicted to porn, and it led to problems. “The first few times I had sex, I was not saying no to things that were not good,” she said. She had nightmares because the content she was watching was so violent and abusive.

Online porn is a multi-million dollar business, driven by algorithms designed to keep people clicking for more. These algorithms push more and more extreme content, often for free, to people who didn’t go searching for it. This can include strangulation, exploitation or incest porn, that’s often misogynistic and racist too.

“If you take incest and strangulation, we can look at content studies from the 1980s, for example, when there was hardly any of that material,” Clare McGlynn, professor of law at Durham University in the UK, tells The Conversation Weekly podcast. “Today both incest and strangulation becomes mainstream.”

In the UK, the government will ban the possession and publication of incest and strangulation porn from early November. McGlynn, who worked with civil society groups to push the regulation of extreme content, says it’s a “huge step” that sends a message about the harms of “normalising sexual violence”.
McGlynn, who has written a recent book about the rise of extreme porn, says large online porn platforms are pushing people towards more and more extreme content.

Their business model is to keep you engaged. They want us on the platform for as long as possible, and the way to do that is to feed you more content, not necessarily what you were looking for, but also, the more extreme, the more polarising, the more shocking content … unfortunately, that seems to be what our kind of base instincts go for and what does actually engage us to keep us searching.
McGlynn says an abundance of extreme and violent porn is shaping the sex lives of young people, and it can lead to an increased risk of problematic behaviour.

There’s a study that followed 16,000 young people, showing that high porn use, particularly at a young age, is a big risk factor in problematic sexual behaviour of young teenage boys. And there’s studies in Australia and the US … showing that the more porn they watch, the more strangulation they see, and then the more they identify that they act out the strangulation.

Disclosure statement Clare McGlynn does not work for, consult, own shares in or receive funding from any company or organisation that would benefit from this article, and has disclosed no relevant affiliations beyond their academic appointment.

enrich.title_zh: 色情内容如何变得如此极端——以及它如何塑造年轻人的性生活
enrich.summary_zh: 文章以歌手比莉·艾利什自述11岁起沉迷色情内容为引子，采访英国杜伦大学法学教授麦格琳，指出大型色情平台靠算法用免费、越来越极端的内容留住用户，使乱伦、扼颈等题材逐渐“主流化”；研究显示高频率观看与青少年男孩的问题性行为相关，英国将从11月初起禁止此类内容的持有与发布。

paragraphs.en: A few years ago, the singer Billie Eilish opened up on the Howard Stern Show about how she began watching porn around age 11.
paragraphs.zh: 几年前，歌手比莉·艾利什（Billie Eilish）在《霍华德·斯特恩秀》节目中坦承，她大约在11岁时开始看色情内容。

paragraphs.en: “I’m so angry that porn is so loved, and I’m so angry at myself for thinking that it was ok,” she said.
paragraphs.zh: “我很愤怒，色情内容竟然如此受欢迎；我也很生自己的气，因为我曾经觉得这没什么。”她说。

paragraphs.en: Eilish became addicted to porn, and it led to problems. “The first few times I had sex, I was not saying no to things that were not good,” she said. She had nightmares because the content she was watching was so violent and abusive.
paragraphs.zh: 艾利什对色情内容上了瘾，并因此出了问题。“最初几次发生性关系时，对那些并不好的事情，我没有说‘不’。”她说。她做噩梦，因为她看的内容如此暴力、充满凌虐。

paragraphs.en: Online porn is a multi-million dollar business, driven by algorithms designed to keep people clicking for more. These algorithms push more and more extreme content, often for free, to people who didn’t go searching for it. This can include strangulation, exploitation or incest porn, that’s often misogynistic and racist too.
paragraphs.zh: 网络色情是一门价值数百万美元的生意，其驱动力是旨在让人不断点击、欲罢不能的算法。这些算法把越来越极端的内容推送给那些根本没有去搜索它们的人，而且常常是免费的。这类内容可能包括扼颈、剥削或乱伦题材的色情片，其中往往还带有厌女与种族主义色彩。

paragraphs.en: “If you take incest and strangulation, we can look at content studies from the 1980s, for example, when there was hardly any of that material,” Clare McGlynn, professor of law at Durham University in the UK, tells The Conversation Weekly podcast. “Today both incest and strangulation becomes mainstream.”
paragraphs.zh: “以乱伦和扼颈为例，我们可以看看20世纪80年代的内容研究——那时这类材料几乎不存在，”英国杜伦大学法学教授克莱尔·麦格琳（Clare McGlynn）对《对话周刊》播客说，“而今天，乱伦和扼颈都成了主流。”

paragraphs.en: In the UK, the government will ban the possession and publication of incest and strangulation porn from early November. McGlynn, who worked with civil society groups to push the regulation of extreme content, says it’s a “huge step” that sends a message about the harms of “normalising sexual violence”.
paragraphs.zh: 在英国，政府将从11月初起禁止持有和发布乱伦与扼颈题材的色情内容。麦格琳曾与民间社会组织合作推动对极端内容的监管，她表示这是“巨大的一步”，传递出“将性暴力正常化”危害何在的信号。

paragraphs.en: McGlynn, who has written a recent book about the rise of extreme porn, says large online porn platforms are pushing people towards more and more extreme content.
paragraphs.zh: 麦格琳 recently 出版了一本关于极端色情内容兴起的书，她说，大型网络色情平台正在把人推向越来越极端的内容。

paragraphs.en: Their business model is to keep you engaged. They want us on the platform for as long as possible, and the way to do that is to feed you more content, not necessarily what you were looking for, but also, the more extreme, the more polarising, the more shocking content … unfortunately, that seems to be what our kind of base instincts go for and what does actually engage us to keep us searching.
paragraphs.zh: 它们的商业模式就是让你保持参与。它们希望我们在平台上停留尽可能长的时间，而做到这一点的方法就是不断喂给你内容——不一定是你要找的东西，还包括那些越极端、越能制造对立、越令人震惊的内容……不幸的是，这似乎正是我们某种原始本能所追逐的东西，也正是真正能抓住我们、让我们不断搜索下去的东西。

paragraphs.en: McGlynn says an abundance of extreme and violent porn is shaping the sex lives of young people, and it can lead to an increased risk of problematic behaviour.
paragraphs.zh: 麦格琳说，大量极端、暴力的色情内容正在塑造年轻人的性生活，并可能提高出现有问题行为的风险。

paragraphs.en: There’s a study that followed 16,000 young people, showing that high porn use, particularly at a young age, is a big risk factor in problematic sexual behaviour of young teenage boys. And there’s studies in Australia and the US … showing that the more porn they watch, the more strangulation they see, and then the more they identify that they act out the strangulation.
paragraphs.zh: 有一项研究追踪了1.6万名年轻人，结果显示，大量观看色情内容——尤其是在年纪很小的时候——是十几岁男孩出现有问题性行为的一个重要风险因素。澳大利亚和美国的研究则显示……他们看的色情内容越多，看到的扼颈场面就越多，随后他们也越多地承认自己真的把扼颈付诸实施。

vocab.meaning_zh: 敞开心扉，坦露（私密的经历或感受）

vocab.meaning_zh: 上瘾的，成瘾的（be addicted to sth）

vocab.meaning_zh: 凌虐的，带有虐待性质的；也可指言语辱骂的

vocab.meaning_zh: 乱伦；乱伦题材的性内容

sentences.en: They want us on the platform for as long as possible, and the way to do that is to feed you more content, not necessarily what you were looking for, but also, the more extreme, the more polarising, the more shocking content …

sentences.en: There’s a study that followed 16,000 young people, showing that high porn use, particularly at a young age, is a big risk factor in problematic sexual behaviour of young teenage boys.

sentences.en: McGlynn, who worked with civil society groups to push the regulation of extreme content, says it’s a “huge step” that sends a message about the harms of “normalising sexual violence”.
sentences.structure: 主干：McGlynn says (that) it’s a “huge step”。修饰：who worked with civil society groups... 为非限制性定语从句，补充主语身份；that sends a message about... 为定语从句修饰 a “huge step”。

background.title: 英国的极端色情立法
background.text_zh: 英国1995年《刑事司法与公共秩序法》第63条早已禁止所谓“极端色情图像”，主要针对涉及生命威胁、严重伤害等情节的性内容，但乱伦题材以及双方“自愿”性行为中的扼颈场面长期处于灰色地带。随着网络平台让这类内容变得随手可得，民间社会组织多年游说，要求把它正式列为违禁内容。文章说的“从11月初起禁止持有和发布”，就是这一监管收紧的结果。理解这一点，才能明白麦格琳为何把它称为“巨大的一步”——法律的着力点不只是个别视频，而是这类内容在文化上被视为“正常”的过程。

title_en: What animal bones in Malawi teach us about the social lives of people long ago
excerpt_en: The bones of animals at an archaeological site in Malawi show that food was scarce over the last 21,000 years, but people didn’t cooperate far and wide to get it.
body_en: The Hora 1 site is at the base of this peak of rock in northern Malawi. Chelsea Smith, CC BY-ND In the ancient past, when human communities were small and the only way to travel was by walking, what were the chances of meeting a stranger? And what would happen next?

We know that ancient people lived by foraging their food from wild plants and animals, but we know a lot less about their social lives. Would there be conflict as people defended territory? Or would they choose to share? Sometimes survival depends on choosing wisely between these options. Defending a territory has a cost, and it’s not always worth it.

To understand how ancient people interacted with one another, we can start by looking at the food they ate. When food resources are densely clustered in predictable ways, it makes sense to establish and maintain a territory around them. When resources are sparsely distributed, they are harder to defend.

One example of territoriality in modern foraging people comes from the Okiek in the mountains of Kenya. Here, families control the crucially important activity of honey-harvesting. In contrast, foraging groups that live in places where the next meal is less predictable also tend to be less territorial. For example, until recently!Kung foragers in the arid parts of the Kalahari Desert searched for animals to hunt across wide areas, and boundaries between groups were much more fluid.

A smoky torch used to harvest honey. Jessica Thompson, CC BY-ND The strategies used by the Okiek and the!Kung are different solutions to the same problem: weighing the risk of going hungry against the risk of unfriendly social encounters.
Applying this principle to archaeological finds can reveal clues about ancient human social organisation. The problem is how to find food remains from the ancient past.

We are archaeologists who do research in Malawi, excavating fossil animal bones and stone tools from natural shelters of rock. Our aim is to understand how early humans lived from the end of the last ice age, between 19,000 and 10,000 years ago, until the start of farming and herd-keeping just a few thousand years ago. Although no glaciers were present in tropical Malawi during the last ice age, global environments were different from today. We wanted to know more about food availability then, and how this might have affected social interactions.

We focused on a large shelter called Hora 1, located on a spectacular granite mountain that emerges like a tooth from the open woodlands in northern Malawi. Traces of ancient human activity are everywhere in this area: red coloured paintings on the rock walls, stone tools made of shiny quartz, hearths, human burials and, in the layers of earth carefully excavated over several visits, hundreds of thousands of bones. These are the remnants of uncountable meals for the communities who lived here.

Hora Mountain rising from the landscape of northern Malawi. Chelsea Smith, CC BY-NC Of this formidable number of broken, cooked, cut, chewed and discarded animal parts we were able to identify almost 13,000 individual fragments, collectively spanning the last 21,000 years of human occupation.

We have published a paper about these fragments and what they tell us about ancient cultural boundaries related to food availability. Our findings challenge the existing view that it was mostly coastal environments that promoted boundary formation in the past.

Hunting close to home Large animals can provide a meal for a large group, so when hunters encounter them, they may prefer to chase them, even if that means ignoring smaller prey. But most of the bones we found belonged to small animals: tiny antelopes, hares, monkeys, and other creatures. That suggests that large prey with a lot of meat – like zebras, wildebeest and even rhinoceroses – were not very common in this valley in the past.

Although the fragments were very small, we could see that they came from everywhere in the body: limbs, torsos and heads were all present. This suggests that these animals were hunted close to the site, and the whole carcass was brought back (not just the best parts of large animals).

The bones indicate that foragers at Hora 1 hunted close to home throughout the thousands of years recorded in the archaeological deposits. We confirmed this by comparing the chemistry of the local geology to chemical traces in the animal teeth: we found that they matched.

The fossil tooth of a wildebeest from HOR-1, an animal that has not been recorded in modern times in this part of Malawi. The lines in the tooth are where small samples were taken for chemical analysis. Ruoyang Tu, CC BY-NC But there is a twist to this story.

The animal bones were extremely fragmented, on average only the size of a little finger. Then we looked at some of the smallest and most nutrient poor bones in the skeleton: the phalanges, or finger and toe bones. Most had been broken open to recover even the smallest amounts of fatty marrow from inside. Probably food was not so abundant in this valley if people spent their time on such meagre packages of nutrients.
So why didn’t people just range further to find more food, and what kept them at that site for so long?
We think the answer lies in their social worlds.

In-group cooperation and out-group hostility We found that animals were of different ages when they died: youngsters, adults, and even animals so old their teeth were worn down. This suggests some form of indiscriminate mass hunting such as the use of nets or traps. It is also possible that fire was used to aid communal game drives of larger animals. All these practices would have required coordination of labour, as well as social norms on how to split the bounty.

enrich.title_zh: 马拉维的动物骨骼，如何讲述远古人类的社交生活

But most of the bones we found belonged to small animals: tiny antelopes, hares, monkeys, and other creatures. That suggests that large prey with a lot of meat – like zebras, wildebeest and even rhinoceroses – were not very common in this valley in the past.
paragraphs.zh: 在家门口狩猎 大型动物能供一大群人吃上一顿，所以猎人一旦遇上，往往更愿意去追捕，即便这意味着放过较小的猎物。但我们发现的骨骼大多属于小型动物：小型羚羊、野兔、猴子和其他动物。这表明，像斑马、角马乃至犀牛这样肉量大的大型猎物，过去在这个山谷里并不十分常见。

paragraphs.en: Although the fragments were very small, we could see that they came from everywhere in the body: limbs, torsos and heads were all present. This suggests that these animals were hunted close to the site, and the whole carcass was brought back (not just the best parts of large animals).
paragraphs.zh: 尽管碎片非常小，但我们能看出它们来自身体的各个部位：四肢、躯干和头部都有。这说明这些动物是在遗址附近被猎杀的，整具尸体都被带了回来（而不是只带回大型动物身上最好的部位）。

paragraphs.en: The bones indicate that foragers at Hora 1 hunted close to home throughout the thousands of years recorded in the archaeological deposits. We confirmed this by comparing the chemistry of the local geology to chemical traces in the animal teeth: we found that they matched.
paragraphs.zh: 这些骨骼表明，在考古堆积所记录的数千年中，Hora 1 的觅食者始终在家门口一带狩猎。我们通过把当地地质的化学特征与动物牙齿中的化学痕迹作比较，证实了这一点：两者是吻合的。

paragraphs.en: The fossil tooth of a wildebeest from HOR-1, an animal that has not been recorded in modern times in this part of Malawi. The lines in the tooth are where small samples were taken for chemical analysis. Ruoyang Tu, CC BY-NC But there is a twist to this story.
paragraphs.zh: 来自 HOR-1 的一颗角马化石牙齿——这种动物在近代记录中已不见于马拉维这一地区。牙上的纹路是钻取少量样品做化学分析的位置。Ruoyang Tu，CC BY-NC 但这个故事还有转折。

paragraphs.en: The animal bones were extremely fragmented, on average only the size of a little finger. Then we looked at some of the smallest and most nutrient poor bones in the skeleton: the phalanges, or finger and toe bones. Most had been broken open to recover even the smallest amounts of fatty marrow from inside. Probably food was not so abundant in this valley if people spent their time on such meagre packages of nutrients.
paragraphs.zh: 这些动物骨骼碎得极其厉害，平均只有小指大小。接着我们观察了骨架中一些最小、营养最贫乏的骨头：指（趾）骨，也就是手指和脚趾的骨头。它们大多被敲开过，为的是取出里面哪怕最少量的一点脂肪骨髓。如果人们要把时间花在如此微薄的「营养包」上，那这个山谷里的食物大概并不丰裕。

paragraphs.en: So why didn’t people just range further to find more food, and what kept them at that site for so long?
paragraphs.zh: 那么，人们为什么不走得更远、去找更多食物？又是什么让他们在那个地点待了这么久？

paragraphs.en: We think the answer lies in their social worlds.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，答案在于他们的社会世界。

paragraphs.en: In-group cooperation and out-group hostility We found that animals were of different ages when they died: youngsters, adults, and even animals so old their teeth were worn down. This suggests some form of indiscriminate mass hunting such as the use of nets or traps. It is also possible that fire was used to aid communal game drives of larger animals. All these practices would have required coordination of labour, as well as social norms on how to split the bounty.
paragraphs.zh: 群体内合作与群体外敌意 我们发现，这些动物死亡时年龄不一：有幼年个体、成年个体，甚至有牙齿都磨平了的老迈个体。这表明存在某种不加挑选的大规模狩猎方式，比如使用网或陷阱。也有可能人们用火来协助集体驱赶大型猎物。所有这些做法都需要劳动的协调，以及关于如何分配战利品的社会规范。

vocab.meaning_zh: （人或动物）觅食，采集野外的食物；（本文名词形式 forager 指「觅食者」，即狩猎采集者）
vocab.example_en: These communities foraged for wild plants and hunted small game.
vocab.example_zh: 这些社群采集野生植物，并猎取小型猎物。

vocab.meaning_zh: 领地性，领域行为；指群体划定并防卫一块地盘的倾向
vocab.example_en: Territoriality tends to be stronger where food is concentrated and predictable.
vocab.example_zh: 在食物集中且可预测的地方，领地性往往更强。

vocab.meaning_zh: （熟词僻义）不固定的、易变的、流动的；此处指群体边界模糊、可变动
vocab.example_en: In the desert, the boundaries between foraging groups were fluid.
vocab.example_zh: 在沙漠中，各觅食群体之间的边界是流动易变的。

vocab.meaning_zh: 发掘（遗址）、挖出；考古学核心动词
vocab.example_en: The team excavated layers of earth containing thousands of bone fragments.
vocab.example_zh: 团队发掘出含有数千块骨骼碎片的土层。

vocab.meaning_zh: （数量、规模）惊人的、令人敬畏的；此处形容骨骼碎片数量之大令人咂舌
vocab.example_en: They faced a formidable pile of broken bone fragments.
vocab.example_zh: 他们面对的是一大堆数量惊人的碎骨。

vocab.meaning_zh: （动物的）尸体，胴体；指被猎杀动物除肉以外的整体躯壳
vocab.example_en: Hunters brought the whole carcass back to the rock shelter.
vocab.example_zh: 猎人们把整具动物尸体带回了岩厦。

vocab.meaning_zh: （英式拼写，美式 meager）微薄的、贫乏的、少得可怜的
vocab.example_en: They survived on the meagre marrow inside tiny toe bones.
vocab.example_zh: 他们靠细小趾骨中那点微薄的骨髓维生。

vocab.meaning_zh: 不加区分、不加挑选的；此处指不论老幼一并猎杀
vocab.example_en: Indiscriminate hunting with nets would catch animals of every age.
vocab.example_zh: 用网不加挑选地狩猎，会捕获各种年龄的动物。

vocab.meaning_zh: （熟词僻义）丰厚的收获、战利品；此处指集体狩猎所得、需要分配的猎物
vocab.example_en: Social norms governed how the bounty was split among the group.
vocab.example_zh: 社会规范决定了战利品在群体中如何分配。

sentences.en: In contrast, foraging groups that live in places where the next meal is less predictable also tend to be less territorial.
sentences.structure: 主干：foraging groups ... tend to be less territorial（主＋系表结构，tend to 表倾向）/ 修饰：that live in places 为定语从句修饰 groups；where the next meal is less predictable 为定语从句修饰 places，形成「从句套从句」。
sentences.analysis_zh: 这是典型的学术英语「层层后置」写法：先说结论（这类群体领地性更弱），再用两个定语从句补充条件。翻译时中文宜把修饰成分前置成「生活在……地方的觅食群体」，但要拆开处理，避免一句里套三个「的」。in contrast 与上文的 Okiek 例子形成对照。

sentences.en: We focused on a large shelter called Hora 1, located on a spectacular granite mountain that emerges like a tooth from the open woodlands in northern Malawi.
sentences.structure: 主干：We focused on a large shelter / 修饰：called Hora 1 为过去分词短语作后置定语；located on a spectacular granite mountain 也是过去分词短语，说明遗址位置；that emerges like a tooth... 为定语从句修饰 mountain。
sentences.analysis_zh: 一个主句挂了三个修饰成分，是科普写作里常见的「镜头由远推近」：先给研究对象，再给地质背景，最后用比喻（像一颗牙齿般拔地而起）给出画面感。翻译时中文可按原顺序推进，把 emerges like a tooth 保留为明喻，不必改成抽象表述。

sentences.en: Our findings challenge the existing view that it was mostly coastal environments that promoted boundary formation in the past.
sentences.structure: 主干：Our findings challenge the existing view / 修饰：that it was mostly coastal environments that... 是同位语从句，解释 view 的内容；该从句内部又是 it was X that... 的强调句型，强调 coastal environments。
sentences.analysis_zh: 这句是全文的「立论句」：不是简单否定旧说，而是用 challenge 这一学术高频动词表明自己的数据与主流解释相冲突。注意同位语从句里套强调句：正常语序应是 mostly coastal environments promoted boundary formation in the past，作者把 coastal environments 提到 it was...that 之间加以凸显，译成中文可用「主要是……促成了……」来保留这层强调。

background.title: 岩厦遗址与马拉维的石器时代
background.text_zh: 岩厦（rock shelter）是天然岩石悬挑形成的浅洞，能遮风避雨、保存沉积物和有机遗存，是非洲考古最重要的遗址类型之一。马拉维位于东非大裂谷南端，其北部高原的晚石器时代（Later Stone Age）遗址中常见石英打制石器、红色赭石岩画、火塘与墓葬。文中提到的「末次冰期」（约 1.9 万年前达到最冷）虽未在热带非洲形成冰川，但全球气候带移动使非洲内陆一度更干冷，植被与猎物分布随之改变——这正是作者想考察「食物可得性如何影响社会关系」的气候背景。

background.title: 奥基克人与昆人：考古学中的民族志类比
background.text_zh: 奥基克人（Okiek）是肯尼亚山地以采蜜为生的族群，蜂巢位置固定且可继承，因而形成了较明确的家庭领地；昆人（!Kung，也称 Ju/'hoansi）是卡拉哈里沙漠的桑人（San）分支，猎物随降雨迁移、难以预测，群体边界松散、人员往来频繁。考古学常以现代觅食社会作「民族志类比」，用来说明资源分布与领地行为之间的关联。这一方法的局限也很明显：现代觅食群体并非「活化石」，他们同样受国家、市场和历史的影响，所以作者只是把它当作假设来源，最终仍靠骨骼证据来检验。

title_en: Is sexual objectification hard-wired? Our study used electrical brain stimulation to find out
excerpt_en: Flipping photos upside down usually exposes a bias in how we see women’s bodies. A weak current to the forehead made it disappear.
body_en: When people view sexualised images of women, they tend to remember them less well than sexualised images of men; a quirk of memory that psychologists link to objectification. But in our new study, my colleagues and I found an unlikely “fix” – applying a mild electrical current to the forehead.

Objectification means seeing someone as a body, or a set of body parts, rather than as a whole person. Our results, published in Social Neuroscience, suggest this bias in perception is not hard-wired and can be changed – at least for a while.

Psychologists measure it with an upside-down test. People are much better at recognising faces and bodies the right way up – typically about 80% right, against 55% upside down – because we take in how all the parts fit together. With objects, such as houses, turning them over matters far less, because we recognise them by their parts.

A 2012 study used this test on sexualised images. Volunteers briefly saw a photo, then had to pick it out from a pair: the photo itself and its mirror image. Men and women alike did far better with men in underwear when the photos were upright, but did about as well with women in similar poses either way – the pattern expected for objects.

The finding has been debated, and some attempts to repeat it have failed. But a 2022 analysis pooling results from 41 papers found the “upright advantage” – how much better people recognise someone the right way up than upside down – is smaller for sexualised women than sexualised men.

Sexually objectified women are seen as less competent and less fully human, and women who absorb this view of themselves tend to have poorer body image and worse mental, physical and sexual health. Exposure to sexualised media is also linked to greater tolerance of sexual violence against women.

The bias also shifts with circumstances. In a 2015 study, blurring out women’s chests and groins, or describing them as medical graduates raising money for cancer research, made people recognise their bodies more like men’s.

Power plays a part. In earlier research in Canada, a colleague and I asked people to spend ten minutes writing about a time they had power over someone, or when someone had power over them. An established way to make people feel powerful or powerless.

Women who felt powerful showed the object-like pattern for sexualised men, and powerful men showed it for sexualised women. People who felt powerless showed the upright advantage for both. Power, rather than gender itself, may be central to objectification.

Where the brain stimulation idea came from The idea of trying brain stimulation came from my lab’s work on a famous illusion. In the Thatcher illusion, first shown with a photo of the former British prime minister, a face with its eyes and mouth turned upside down looks grotesque the right way up but almost normal upside down.

Turning “Thatcherised” faces upside down also hurts recognition much less than it does with ordinary faces – just as with sexualised women. We had found that the same weak current made Thatcherised faces easier to recognise the right way up, bringing back the usual difference. Would it do the same for sexualised women?

The Thatcher illusion. In our new study, 76 university students tried to memorise photos of male and female models posing in underwear – half of them upside down. They then saw the same photos again, each the same way up as before and mixed with 32 new ones, and said whether they had seen each one before.

Half the students received a weak current for ten minutes, using a technique called transcranial direct current stimulation. The others received a placebo that switched off after 30 seconds – a standard way of mimicking the tingle of the real thing. Neither the students nor the researchers testing them knew who got which.

The placebo group showed the familiar pattern. They remembered men far better when the photos were upright than when upside down. For women, the difference was much smaller, mainly because they remembered upright women less well than upright men.
In the stimulated group, recognition of upright images of women improved, and the gap between images of men and women disappeared. The current did not change the upright advantage for images of men.

Why? Our best explanation comes from a theory of how people learn to see. With experience, the brain learns to play down features that all faces share and to pick out the details that tell one person from another.

But some shared features grab attention instead, such as the flipped eyes and mouth of a Thatcherised face – or, we suspect, the body parts on display in sexualised images. They crowd out the details that tell one person from another. The current may weaken that pull.

Our study was a single lab session with university students, and we only measured its immediate effects, not attitudes or behaviour. Because every image was sexualised, we also cannot say how much of the gap comes from sexualisation itself rather than other differences between the photos.

Brain stimulation is no cure for sexism. But if ten minutes of a weak current – or ten minutes spent writing about feeling powerful or powerless – can shift how people see a body, objectification looks less like a fixed feature of human vision and more like a habit. And habits, unlike hard-wiring, can change.

enrich.title_zh: 性客体化是天生的吗？我们用脑电刺激寻找答案
enrich.summary_zh: 文章介绍了一项发表在《社会神经科学》上的研究：人们识别性化女性图像时，倒置带来的识别损失明显小于性化男性图像，这种模式与识别物体相似，被视为客体化的知觉标志。研究者用经颅直流电刺激作用于被试前额十分钟，发现正立女性图像的识别成绩提高，男女图像之间的差距消失。作者强调这只是单次实验、只测即时效果，但至少说明客体化更像可改的习惯，而非先天固定的视觉机制。

paragraphs.en: When people view sexualised images of women, they tend to remember them less well than sexualised images of men; a quirk of memory that psychologists link to objectification. But in our new study, my colleagues and I found an unlikely “fix” – applying a mild electrical current to the forehead.
paragraphs.zh: 当人们观看女性的性化图像时，相比男性的性化图像，他们往往记得更差；心理学家把这种记忆上的古怪现象与客体化联系起来。但在我们的新研究中，我和同事发现了一个意想不到的“修复办法”——在额头上施加微弱电流。

paragraphs.en: Objectification means seeing someone as a body, or a set of body parts, rather than as a whole person. Our results, published in Social Neuroscience, suggest this bias in perception is not hard-wired and can be changed – at least for a while.
paragraphs.zh: 客体化意味着把某人看作一具身体、或一组身体部位，而不是一个完整的人。我们发表在《社会神经科学》（Social Neuroscience）上的结果表明，这种知觉偏差并非天生固定，是可以改变的——至少能维持一段时间。

paragraphs.en: Psychologists measure it with an upside-down test. People are much better at recognising faces and bodies the right way up – typically about 80% right, against 55% upside down – because we take in how all the parts fit together. With objects, such as houses, turning them over matters far less, because we recognise them by their parts.
paragraphs.zh: 心理学家用一个“倒置测试”来测量它。人对正立的面孔和身体的识别能力远好于倒置的——通常正立时正确率约80%，倒置时约55%——因为我们会把握各部分是如何拼合在一起的。而对于物体，比如房子，把它翻转过来影响就小得多，因为我们是通过各个部件来识别它们的。

paragraphs.en: A 2012 study used this test on sexualised images. Volunteers briefly saw a photo, then had to pick it out from a pair: the photo itself and its mirror image. Men and women alike did far better with men in underwear when the photos were upright, but did about as well with women in similar poses either way – the pattern expected for objects.
paragraphs.zh: 2012年的一项研究把这一测试用于性化图像。志愿者短暂地看一张照片，然后要从一对图片中把它挑出来：原图和它的镜像。无论男女被试，当照片正立时，他们对穿内裤的男性的识别成绩都远好于倒置时；但对姿势相似的女性，正立与倒置的成绩差不多——这正是人们识别物体时预期会出现的模式。

paragraphs.en: The finding has been debated, and some attempts to repeat it have failed. But a 2022 analysis pooling results from 41 papers found the “upright advantage” – how much better people recognise someone the right way up than upside down – is smaller for sexualised women than sexualised men.
paragraphs.zh: 这一发现一直有争议，一些重复实验也未能得到相同结果。但2022年一项汇总了41篇论文结果的分析发现，对于性化的女性，“正立优势”——即人识别正立人物比识别倒置人物好多少——小于性化的男性。

paragraphs.en: Sexually objectified women are seen as less competent and less fully human, and women who absorb this view of themselves tend to have poorer body image and worse mental, physical and sexual health. Exposure to sexualised media is also linked to greater tolerance of sexual violence against women.
paragraphs.zh: 被性客体化的女性会被认为能力更低、也更不像一个完整的人；而把这种看法内化到自己身上的女性，往往身体意象更差，心理、生理和性健康状况也更糟。接触性化媒体还与对针对女性的性暴力更为宽容有关。

paragraphs.en: The bias also shifts with circumstances. In a 2015 study, blurring out women’s chests and groins, or describing them as medical graduates raising money for cancer research, made people recognise their bodies more like men’s.
paragraphs.zh: 这种偏差还会随情境而改变。在2015年的一项研究中，把女性的胸部和下身模糊处理，或者把她们描述成为了癌症研究筹款的医科毕业生，都会让人们识别其身体的方式变得更接近识别男性身体的方式。

paragraphs.en: Power plays a part. In earlier research in Canada, a colleague and I asked people to spend ten minutes writing about a time they had power over someone, or when someone had power over them. An established way to make people feel powerful or powerless.
paragraphs.zh: 权力也在其中起作用。在加拿大早先的一项研究中，我和一位同事请人们花十分钟写下自己掌控他人的经历，或他人掌控自己的经历。这是让人感到自己有权或无权的一种成熟方法。

paragraphs.en: Women who felt powerful showed the object-like pattern for sexualised men, and powerful men showed it for sexualised women. People who felt powerless showed the upright advantage for both. Power, rather than gender itself, may be central to objectification.
paragraphs.zh: 感到自己有权的女性对性化男性表现出“物体式”的识别模式，有权的男性则对性化女性表现出这种模式。感到自己无权的人对两者都表现出正立优势。可见，起核心作用的也许是权力，而不是性别本身。

paragraphs.en: Where the brain stimulation idea came from The idea of trying brain stimulation came from my lab’s work on a famous illusion. In the Thatcher illusion, first shown with a photo of the former British prime minister, a face with its eyes and mouth turned upside down looks grotesque the right way up but almost normal upside down.
paragraphs.zh: 脑刺激的想法从何而来　尝试脑刺激的想法，源于我实验室对一种著名错觉的研究。在撒切尔错觉中（最初是用英国前首相的一张照片展示的），一张眼睛和嘴巴被上下翻转的脸，正立时看起来怪异扭曲，倒置时却几乎正常。

paragraphs.en: Turning “Thatcherised” faces upside down also hurts recognition much less than it does with ordinary faces – just as with sexualised women. We had found that the same weak current made Thatcherised faces easier to recognise the right way up, bringing back the usual difference. Would it do the same for sexualised women?
paragraphs.zh: 把“撒切尔化”的脸倒置，对识别造成的损害也远小于普通面孔——正如性化女性的情况一样。我们已经发现，同样的微弱电流能让撒切尔化的脸在正立时更容易被识别，从而恢复了通常的差异。那么，它对性化女性是否也有同样的效果？

paragraphs.en: The Thatcher illusion. In our new study, 76 university students tried to memorise photos of male and female models posing in underwear – half of them upside down. They then saw the same photos again, each the same way up as before and mixed with 32 new ones, and said whether they had seen each one before.
paragraphs.zh: 撒切尔错觉。在我们的新研究中，76名大学生尝试记住穿着内衣摆姿势的男女模特的照片——其中一半是倒置的。之后他们再次看到这些照片，每张的朝向与之前相同，并与32张新照片混在一起，然后说出自己此前是否见过每一张。

paragraphs.en: Half the students received a weak current for ten minutes, using a technique called transcranial direct current stimulation. The others received a placebo that switched off after 30 seconds – a standard way of mimicking the tingle of the real thing. Neither the students nor the researchers testing them knew who got which.
paragraphs.zh: 一半学生接受了十分钟的微弱电流，使用的是“经颅直流电刺激”技术。其他人接受的是一种安慰性处理，30秒后电流即关闭——这是模拟真实刺激刺痛感的标准做法。学生和负责测试的研究者都不知道谁接受了哪种处理。

paragraphs.en: The placebo group showed the familiar pattern. They remembered men far better when the photos were upright than when upside down. For women, the difference was much smaller, mainly because they remembered upright women less well than upright men.
paragraphs.zh: 安慰剂组表现出我们熟悉的模式。照片正立时，他们对男性的记忆远好于倒置时。对女性而言，这一差异要小得多，主要原因是他们对正立女性的记忆不如对正立男性的记忆。

paragraphs.en: In the stimulated group, recognition of upright images of women improved, and the gap between images of men and women disappeared. The current did not change the upright advantage for images of men.
paragraphs.zh: 在接受刺激的组里，对正立女性图像的识别有所改善，男女图像之间的差距消失了。电流并没有改变男性图像的正立优势。

paragraphs.en: Why? Our best explanation comes from a theory of how people learn to see. With experience, the brain learns to play down features that all faces share and to pick out the details that tell one person from another.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么？我们最好的解释来自一种关于人如何学会“看”的理论。随着经验积累，大脑学会淡化所有面孔共有的特征，并挑出那些能区分不同人的细节。

paragraphs.en: But some shared features grab attention instead, such as the flipped eyes and mouth of a Thatcherised face – or, we suspect, the body parts on display in sexualised images. They crowd out the details that tell one person from another. The current may weaken that pull.
paragraphs.zh: 但有些共有特征反而会抓住注意力，比如撒切尔化面孔中翻转的眼睛和嘴巴——或者，我们怀疑，还包括性化图像中所展示的身体部位。它们挤占了那些能区分不同人的细节。电流可能削弱了这种吸引力。

paragraphs.en: Our study was a single lab session with university students, and we only measured its immediate effects, not attitudes or behaviour. Because every image was sexualised, we also cannot say how much of the gap comes from sexualisation itself rather than other differences between the photos.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究只是针对大学生的单次实验室测试，而且只测量了即时效果，没有测量态度或行为。由于每张图片都是性化的，我们也无法判断这种差距中有多少来自性化本身，而不是照片之间的其他差异。

paragraphs.en: Brain stimulation is no cure for sexism. But if ten minutes of a weak current – or ten minutes spent writing about feeling powerful or powerless – can shift how people see a body, objectification looks less like a fixed feature of human vision and more like a habit. And habits, unlike hard-wiring, can change.
paragraphs.zh: 脑刺激并不是性别歧视的解药。但如果十分钟的微弱电流——或者花十分钟书写自己感到有权或无权——就能改变人们看待一具身体的方式，那么客体化看起来就不像人类视觉的某种固定特征，而更像一种习惯。而习惯不同于先天构造，是可以改变的。

vocab.meaning_zh: 客体化；把人物化（把人只看作身体或身体部位，而非完整的人）
vocab.example_en: Objectification means seeing someone as a body rather than as a whole person.
vocab.example_zh: 客体化意味着把某人看作一具身体，而不是一个完整的人。

vocab.meaning_zh: （本能、机制等）先天固定的、写死在生理构造里的，难以改变的
vocab.example_en: The study suggests this bias in perception is not hard-wired.
vocab.example_zh: 这项研究表明，这种知觉偏差并非先天固定。

vocab.meaning_zh: （行为或现象中）古怪而出人意料的特点、蹊跷之处
vocab.example_en: A quirk of memory makes us recall faces differently from objects.
vocab.example_zh: 记忆上的一个古怪特点使我们记面孔和记物体的方式不同。

vocab.meaning_zh: 怪异扭曲的、荒诞难看的
vocab.example_en: The face looks grotesque the right way up but almost normal upside down.
vocab.example_zh: 这张脸正立时看起来怪异扭曲，倒置时却几乎正常。

vocab.meaning_zh: （实验中的）安慰性处理、假处理；安慰剂
vocab.example_en: The others received a placebo that switched off after 30 seconds.
vocab.example_zh: 其他人接受的是一种30秒后即关闭的安慰性处理。

vocab.meaning_zh: 刺痛感、酥麻感
vocab.example_en: The placebo mimics the tingle of the real current.
vocab.example_zh: 安慰性处理模拟了真实电流带来的刺痛感。

vocab.meaning_zh: 把……挤掉、排挤出去（此处指共有特征占据注意力，使细节无法被加工）
vocab.example_en: Striking shared features crowd out the details that tell one person from another.
vocab.example_zh: 那些扎眼的共有特征挤占了区分不同人的细节。

vocab.meaning_zh: 淡化、降低……的重要性
vocab.example_en: The brain learns to play down features that all faces share.
vocab.example_zh: 大脑学会淡化所有面孔共有的特征。

sentences.en: When people view sexualised images of women, they tend to remember them less well than sexualised images of men; a quirk of memory that psychologists link to objectification.
sentences.structure: 主干：they tend to remember them less well（主＋谓语＋状语比较结构）/ 修饰：When 引导时间状语从句；than sexualised images of men 作比较对象；分号后 a quirk of memory 是前面整句的同位语，that psychologists link to objectification 是定语从句修饰 a quirk。
sentences.analysis_zh: 这句话用比较结构（less well than）把“记女性图像更差”这一现象一句话交代清楚，再用分号补一个同位语名词短语，把现象“命名”为 a quirk of memory，并挂上定语从句点出它与 objectification 的关系。这种“陈述现象 + 分号命名”的写法在外刊中很常见，好处是既给事实又给学术标签，读者能迅速抓住文章要讨论的概念。翻译时不宜把同位语硬译成“这是一个……的怪现象”，可用“；心理学家把这种记忆上的古怪现象与……联系起来”拆开处理。

sentences.en: Men and women alike did far better with men in underwear when the photos were upright, but did about as well with women in similar poses either way – the pattern expected for objects.
sentences.structure: 主干：Men and women alike did far better ..., but did about as well ...（并列谓语）/ 修饰：with men in underwear、with women in similar poses 是对象状语；when the photos were upright 是时间状语从句；either way 作方式状语；破折号后 the pattern expected for objects 是同位语，expected for objects 为过去分词短语后置修饰 pattern。
sentences.analysis_zh: 句子靠 but 把两种结果对举：对男性图像，正立远好于倒置（far better ... when upright）；对女性图像，正立倒置差不多（about as well ... either way）。破折号后的名词短语不构成完整句子，作用是把前面的实验结果“翻译”成一个理论标签——这正是识别物体时的模式，为下文引出 objectification 做铺垫。注意 either way（两种朝向都）和 alike（男女都一样）都是极简但信息量大的外刊常用副词。

sentences.en: But if ten minutes of a weak current – or ten minutes spent writing about feeling powerful or powerless – can shift how people see a body, objectification looks less like a fixed feature of human vision and more like a habit.
sentences.structure: 主干：objectification looks less like ... and more like a habit（主＋系动词＋并列表语）/ 修饰：if 引导条件状语从句，其主语是 ten minutes of a weak current，破折号插入 or ten minutes spent writing about ... 作为并列主语，spent 为过去分词后置修饰 ten minutes；从句宾语是 how people see a body（宾语从句）。
sentences.analysis_zh: 结尾句用 less like ... and more like ... 这一对比框架给全文定性：把客体化从“视觉的固定特征”重新归类为“习惯”。条件状语从句的主语被破折号插入语拉长，阅读时先跳过插入成分抓住 ten minutes ... can shift 这一骨架即可。这样写的好处是把实验操作（十分钟电刺激）与另一个研究（十分钟写作）并列，暗示改变的关键也许不是电流本身，而是“短暂干预”这件事。

background.title: 经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）
background.text_zh: 文中提到的 transcranial direct current stimulation 是一种非侵入式脑刺激技术：把两个电极贴在头皮上，通以1–2毫安的微弱直流电，持续十几分钟，理论上可以轻微改变电极下方脑区神经元的兴奋性。它因操作简单、成本低而被大量用于认知与知觉研究，但效应量通常很小、个体差异大，且结果重复性存在争议。实验中的标准做法是设置“伪刺激”对照——电流30秒后自动关闭，被试只感到最初的刺痛，从而保证双盲。这也解释了文中“学生和研究者都不知道谁接受哪种处理”的设计。

background.title: 倒置效应与撒切尔错觉
background.text_zh: 人识别面孔时存在明显的“倒置效应”：把照片翻转180度后识别成绩大幅下降，而识别房子、椅子等物体时下降很小。心理学据此认为，面孔（以及被当作整体加工的身体）是以“整体构型”方式加工的，物体则更多依赖局部特征。撒切尔错觉（Thatcher illusion）是这一研究传统的经典演示：把面孔的眼睛和嘴巴单独上下翻转、其余保持正立，正立观看时显得极其怪异，整张脸倒过来看却几乎正常——说明倒置破坏了整体加工，怪异感随之消失。本文正是借这条线索，把“性化女性被像物体一样加工”与“撒切尔化面孔”联系起来。

title_en: 70 years ago the Suez crisis exposed British relative decline. Today, the Iran conflict could be doing the same for the US
excerpt_en: Suez showed that Britain had lost the leeway to behave like a superpower.
body_en: Like the Strait of Hormuz, the Suez Canal is a vital waterway for global trade. Viktor Hladchenko/Shutterstock Months after the US and Israel launched Operation Epic Fury against Iran, the Strait of Hormuz remains largely closed. The UK chose not to get directly involved in the conflict. Nonetheless, it has been exposed to the crisis through record-high diesel prices as well as a spike in inflation.
This echoes an earlier crisis in the Middle East, as my recent research illustrates.

Seventy years ago, the Egyptian government nationalised the Suez canal, sparking the Suez crisis. The canal, which passes through Egypt from the Red Sea to the Mediterranean, was a vital link for ships travelling between Europe and Asia.

After its completion in 1869 by a French-led company, the Egyptian government held a 44% stake in it. However, financial difficulties forced Egypt to sell its shares to the British government in 1875, leaving Britain and France with substantial financial interests in the canal.

Following the Egyptian nationalisation of the canal, France and Britain – together with Israel – invaded Egypt in an attempt to regain control of the vital waterway. But the invasion was a spectacular failure that was condemned by the international community. The crisis came to symbolise Britain’s loss of superpower status.

Today, the US midterm elections are increasing the pressure on the Trump administration over the current conflict. Elections in Israel have also had some bearing on the conflict, with recent reports that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pushed for renewed strikes ahead of the election. Other reports suggest that the US and Israel have drawn up plans to resume strikes after the elections.

In 1956, US presidential elections were also an important part of the calculus. But back then, Britain and France had assumed that the elections would distract the US from their actions. This was a miscalculation. In communication with UK Prime Minister Anthony Eden the day after the vote, US President Dwight D. Eisenhower was clear that his administration would not tolerate the UK, France and Israel’s continued actions. He demanded a negotiated settlement through the UN.
The parallels between Suez and Hormuz go beyond the closure of two vital waterways. Both crises raise the same question: how far can geopolitical power outrun economic power?

Superpowers in decline In 1944, the American foreign policy professor William T.R. Fox coined the term “super-power”. He defined it as the consequence of “great wealth, great population, and favourable geographic position”. This is similar to how the historian Phillips O’Brien defines great power today. Fox saw three superpowers at that time: the US, Britain, and the Soviet Union. He later acknowledged that including Britain had been a mistake, primarily because of its relative decline against the US and later the rest of Europe.
Arguably a similar shift is taking place today.

There are arguments over what is the best measure of an economy, but on the basis of purchasing power the shift is striking. China has moved from being a fraction of the size of the US economy in 1990 to being well ahead today.

In the 19th century, Britain was the dominant global power and benefited from what economists call “exorbitant privilege”. This was the ability to easily finance debt at favourable interest rates because sterling played a central role in the international monetary system. London was also the world’s leading financial centre.

But as Britain declined, this privilege gradually shifted towards the US. Its loss became particularly pressing during the Suez crisis as the pound came under intense pressure. Similarly today, there are signs of strain in the financial system that underpins American power.
During the Suez crisis, Britain’s currency weakness and dependence on American financial support constrained its ability to act independently, despite its considerable military power.

The crisis was also part of wider cold war geopolitics. An arms deal signed in 1955 between Egypt and the Soviet Union had upset the regional balance of power and contributed to Israel’s decision to get involved in a preventative war.

In response to the arms deal, the US withdrew financing for the Aswan Dam, a major infrastructure project on the River Nile. Then, in 1956, Egypt nationalised the Suez canal, sparking the crisis. British leaders sought to portray Egyptian president Gamal Abdel Nasser as a 1930s dictator, intent on regional dominance.

Egyptian president Gamal Abdel Nasser nationalised the Suez Canal in 1956. Wikimedia Commons The US intervention in Iran has similar connotations. US secretary of war Pete Hegseth has presented the assassination of the Iranian leadership as necessary to prevent an existential threat from “America’s mortal enemy”.

Geoeconomics, the relationship between economics and geopolitics, also played a central role in the Suez crisis. The canal was a major conduit for Middle Eastern oil and there were fears that the nationalisation of the canal would disrupt UK oil supplies. But ironically, it was the decision to invade Egypt that led to a shortage of oil and fuel rationing in the UK.

The wider cold war was a key factor in the US stance on events. The US did not want to be seen to be condoning imperial actions in Egypt while condemning Russian imperialism in Hungary. Just as the Suez crisis needs to be understood in the context of the cold war, the current conflict should also be seen through the lens of “cold war II” geopolitics. Relations between the US and China have not thawed, while proxy wars bear similarities to the first cold war.

enrich.title_zh: 70年前苏伊士运河危机暴露了英国的相对衰落，今天的伊朗冲突或许正在让美国重蹈覆辙
enrich.summary_zh: 文章把当前美以对伊朗开战、霍尔木兹海峡封锁引发的危机，与1956年埃及将苏伊士运河收归国有引发的苏伊士运河危机作对比。作者指出，两场危机都不只是航道关闭问题，更暴露了「地缘政治力量跑得比经济力量更远」的落差：当年英镑受制于美国金融杠杆，英国由此丧失超级大国地位；如今购买力格局与金融体系压力显示，美国或许正经历类似的相对衰落。

paragraphs.en: Like the Strait of Hormuz, the Suez Canal is a vital waterway for global trade. Viktor Hladchenko/Shutterstock Months after the US and Israel launched Operation Epic Fury against Iran, the Strait of Hormuz remains largely closed. The UK chose not to get directly involved in the conflict. Nonetheless, it has been exposed to the crisis through record-high diesel prices as well as a spike in inflation.
paragraphs.zh: 与霍尔木兹海峡一样，苏伊士运河是全球贸易的咽喉要道。Viktor Hladchenko/Shutterstock（图片说明） 在美国和以色列对伊朗发动「史诗之怒」行动数月之后，霍尔木兹海峡仍基本处于封锁状态。英国选择不直接卷入这场冲突。但即便如此，它仍因创纪录的柴油价格和通胀的飙升而受到这场危机的冲击。

paragraphs.en: This echoes an earlier crisis in the Middle East, as my recent research illustrates.
paragraphs.zh: 正如我最近的研究所显示的那样，这与早年中东的一场危机如出一辙。

paragraphs.en: Seventy years ago, the Egyptian government nationalised the Suez canal, sparking the Suez crisis. The canal, which passes through Egypt from the Red Sea to the Mediterranean, was a vital link for ships travelling between Europe and Asia.
paragraphs.zh: 七十年前，埃及政府将苏伊士运河收归国有，引发了苏伊士运河危机。这条运河从红海穿过埃及通往地中海，是往来于欧洲与亚洲之间的船只的关键通道。

paragraphs.en: After its completion in 1869 by a French-led company, the Egyptian government held a 44% stake in it. However, financial difficulties forced Egypt to sell its shares to the British government in 1875, leaving Britain and France with substantial financial interests in the canal.
paragraphs.zh: 1869年，运河由一家法国主导的公司建成，此后埃及政府持有其44%的股份。然而财政困难迫使埃及在1875年把股份卖给英国政府，于是英法两国在运河中拥有了巨大的经济利益。

paragraphs.en: Following the Egyptian nationalisation of the canal, France and Britain – together with Israel – invaded Egypt in an attempt to regain control of the vital waterway. But the invasion was a spectacular failure that was condemned by the international community. The crisis came to symbolise Britain’s loss of superpower status.
paragraphs.zh: 埃及将运河收归国有后，法国和英国——连同以色列——入侵埃及，试图重新控制这条关键水道。但这场入侵彻底失败，并遭到国际社会谴责。这场危机后来成为英国丧失超级大国地位的象征。

paragraphs.en: Today, the US midterm elections are increasing the pressure on the Trump administration over the current conflict. Elections in Israel have also had some bearing on the conflict, with recent reports that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pushed for renewed strikes ahead of the election. Other reports suggest that the US and Israel have drawn up plans to resume strikes after the elections.
paragraphs.zh: 今天，美国中期选举正因当前冲突而加大特朗普政府面临的压力。以色列的选举也对这场冲突产生了影响：近期有报道称，总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡在选举前力主恢复打击。另有报道称，美以双方已拟定在选举结束后恢复打击的计划。

paragraphs.en: In 1956, US presidential elections were also an important part of the calculus. But back then, Britain and France had assumed that the elections would distract the US from their actions. This was a miscalculation. In communication with UK Prime Minister Anthony Eden the day after the vote, US President Dwight D. Eisenhower was clear that his administration would not tolerate the UK, France and Israel’s continued actions. He demanded a negotiated settlement through the UN.
paragraphs.zh: 1956年时，美国总统大选同样是各方盘算中的重要一环。但当时英法以为，大选会让美国无暇顾及它们的行动。这是一次误判。投票次日，美国总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔在与英国首相安东尼·艾登的沟通中明确表示，他的政府不会容忍英、法、以三国的持续行动。他要求通过联合国以谈判方式解决。

paragraphs.en: The parallels between Suez and Hormuz go beyond the closure of two vital waterways. Both crises raise the same question: how far can geopolitical power outrun economic power?
paragraphs.zh: 苏伊士与霍尔木兹之间的相似之处，并不止于两条关键水道被封锁。两场危机都提出了同一个问题：地缘政治力量究竟能比经济力量跑出多远？

paragraphs.en: Superpowers in decline In 1944, the American foreign policy professor William T.R. Fox coined the term “super-power”. He defined it as the consequence of “great wealth, great population, and favourable geographic position”. This is similar to how the historian Phillips O’Brien defines great power today. Fox saw three superpowers at that time: the US, Britain, and the Soviet Union. He later acknowledged that including Britain had been a mistake, primarily because of its relative decline against the US and later the rest of Europe.
paragraphs.zh: 衰落中的超级大国 1944年，美国外交政策学者威廉·T·R·福克斯创造了「超级大国」（super-power）一词。他把它定义为「巨大财富、庞大人口与有利地理位置」的结果。这与历史学家菲利普斯·奥布莱恩今天界定「大国」的方式相似。福克斯当时认为世界上有三个超级大国：美国、英国和苏联。他后来承认，把英国算进去是一个错误，主要原因是英国相对于美国、以及后来相对于欧洲其他国家的衰落。

paragraphs.en: Arguably a similar shift is taking place today.
paragraphs.zh: 可以说，今天正在发生类似的位移。

paragraphs.en: There are arguments over what is the best measure of an economy, but on the basis of purchasing power the shift is striking. China has moved from being a fraction of the size of the US economy in 1990 to being well ahead today.
paragraphs.zh: 关于用什么指标衡量经济最合适，人们存在争论；但若以购买力为基准，这种位移就相当惊人了。1990年，中国的经济规模还只是美国的一小部分，如今已明显领先。

paragraphs.en: In the 19th century, Britain was the dominant global power and benefited from what economists call “exorbitant privilege”. This was the ability to easily finance debt at favourable interest rates because sterling played a central role in the international monetary system. London was also the world’s leading financial centre.
paragraphs.zh: 19世纪，英国是全球主导力量，并受益于经济学家所说的「过度特权」。这指的是：由于英镑在国际货币体系中处于核心地位，英国能够以有利的利率轻松为债务融资。伦敦当时也是世界头号金融中心。

paragraphs.en: But as Britain declined, this privilege gradually shifted towards the US. Its loss became particularly pressing during the Suez crisis as the pound came under intense pressure. Similarly today, there are signs of strain in the financial system that underpins American power.
paragraphs.zh: 但随着英国衰落，这项特权逐渐转移到美国手中。在苏伊士运河危机期间，随着英镑承受巨大压力，失去这项特权的痛感变得尤为迫切。同样地，今天支撑美国力量的金融体系也出现了紧张的迹象。

paragraphs.en: During the Suez crisis, Britain’s currency weakness and dependence on American financial support constrained its ability to act independently, despite its considerable military power.
paragraphs.zh: 苏伊士运河危机期间，英国货币疲软并依赖美国的财政支持，这限制了它独立行动的能力，尽管它拥有相当可观的军事力量。

paragraphs.en: The crisis was also part of wider cold war geopolitics. An arms deal signed in 1955 between Egypt and the Soviet Union had upset the regional balance of power and contributed to Israel’s decision to get involved in a preventative war.
paragraphs.zh: 这场危机也是更广泛的冷战地缘政治的一部分。1955年埃及与苏联签署的一项军火协议打破了地区力量平衡，也促成了以色列决定参与一场先发制人的战争。

paragraphs.en: In response to the arms deal, the US withdrew financing for the Aswan Dam, a major infrastructure project on the River Nile. Then, in 1956, Egypt nationalised the Suez canal, sparking the crisis. British leaders sought to portray Egyptian president Gamal Abdel Nasser as a 1930s dictator, intent on regional dominance.
paragraphs.zh: 作为对这项军火协议的反应，美国撤回了对阿斯旺大坝的融资——那是尼罗河上的一项重大基础设施工程。随后在1956年，埃及将苏伊士运河收归国有，引发了这场危机。英国领导人试图把埃及总统贾迈勒·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔描绘成一个一心谋求地区霸权的20世纪30年代式独裁者。

paragraphs.en: Egyptian president Gamal Abdel Nasser nationalised the Suez Canal in 1956. Wikimedia Commons The US intervention in Iran has similar connotations. US secretary of war Pete Hegseth has presented the assassination of the Iranian leadership as necessary to prevent an existential threat from “America’s mortal enemy”.
paragraphs.zh: 埃及总统贾迈勒·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔于1956年将苏伊士运河收归国有。Wikimedia Commons（图片说明） 美国对伊朗的干预也有类似的意涵。美国战争部长皮特·赫格塞思把刺杀伊朗领导层说成是必要之举，用以防止来自「美国死敌」的生存性威胁。

paragraphs.en: Geoeconomics, the relationship between economics and geopolitics, also played a central role in the Suez crisis. The canal was a major conduit for Middle Eastern oil and there were fears that the nationalisation of the canal would disrupt UK oil supplies. But ironically, it was the decision to invade Egypt that led to a shortage of oil and fuel rationing in the UK.
paragraphs.zh: 地缘经济学，即经济与地缘政治之间的关系，在苏伊士运河危机中也发挥了核心作用。运河是中东石油外运的主要通道，当时人们担心运河国有化会打乱英国的石油供应。但颇具讽刺意味的是，正是入侵埃及的决定导致英国出现石油短缺和燃料配给。

paragraphs.en: The wider cold war was a key factor in the US stance on events. The US did not want to be seen to be condoning imperial actions in Egypt while condemning Russian imperialism in Hungary. Just as the Suez crisis needs to be understood in the context of the cold war, the current conflict should also be seen through the lens of “cold war II” geopolitics. Relations between the US and China have not thawed, while proxy wars bear similarities to the first cold war.
paragraphs.zh: 更广泛的冷战格局是美国对事态采取何等立场的一个关键因素。美国不想一边谴责俄国在匈牙利的帝国主义行径，一边又被看作是在纵容埃及的帝国式行动。正如苏伊士运河危机需要放在冷战背景下理解，当前冲突也应透过「第二次冷战」地缘政治的透镜来看。美中关系并未解冻，而代理人战争与第一次冷战也有相似之处。

vocab.meaning_zh: 把……收归国有，实行国有化（本文指埃及把运河公司收归国家所有）
vocab.example_en: The government announced plans to nationalise the country's largest private bank.
vocab.example_zh: 政府宣布计划将该国最大的私营银行收归国有。

vocab.meaning_zh: 对……有影响，与……有关联（外刊高频搭配，比 affect 更书面）
vocab.example_en: The timing of the vote has a direct bearing on how investors will react.
vocab.example_zh: 投票的时间安排直接影响投资者将如何反应。

vocab.meaning_zh: （政治、策略上的）盘算、算计、考量；此处不是「微积分」
vocab.example_en: Electoral calculus, not principle, drove the decision.
vocab.example_zh: 促成这一决定的是选举算计，而不是原则。

vocab.meaning_zh: 误判，算计错误
vocab.example_en: The invasion turned out to be a disastrous miscalculation.
vocab.example_zh: 这场入侵最终被证明是一次灾难性的误判。

vocab.meaning_zh: 跑得比……快；超过，超出……的范围
vocab.example_en: Demand for electricity has outrun the grid's capacity.
vocab.example_zh: 电力需求已经超出电网的承载能力。

vocab.meaning_zh: 「过度特权」，国际金融术语，指美元（当年是英镑）作为储备货币给发行国带来的低成本融资等好处
vocab.example_en: The dollar's exorbitant privilege lets Washington borrow cheaply.
vocab.example_zh: 美元的「过度特权」让华盛顿得以低成本借债。

vocab.meaning_zh: 通道，管道；（资金、资源、信息）输送渠道
vocab.example_en: The canal has long been a conduit for Gulf oil exports.
vocab.example_zh: 这条运河长期以来一直是海湾石油出口的通道。

vocab.meaning_zh: 纵容，默许，宽恕（多用于批评语境）
vocab.example_en: No government should condone the use of chemical weapons.
vocab.example_zh: 任何政府都不应纵容使用化学武器。

vocab.meaning_zh: （物资）定量配给制
vocab.example_en: Fuel rationing was introduced within weeks of the invasion.
vocab.example_zh: 入侵后几周内就实行了燃料配给。

vocab.meaning_zh: 代理人战争，指大国借助第三方势力进行的间接对抗
vocab.example_en: The conflict is widely described as a proxy war between rival powers.
vocab.example_zh: 这场冲突被普遍描述为对立大国之间的代理人战争。

sentences.en: In communication with UK Prime Minister Anthony Eden the day after the vote, US President Dwight D. Eisenhower was clear that his administration would not tolerate the UK, France and Israel's continued actions.
sentences.structure: 主干：Eisenhower was clear that...（主语＋系动词＋形容词＋that 从句）；修饰：In communication with... 为介词短语作状语，the day after the vote 为时间状语；that 从句说明 clear 的内容，作形容词的补足语（可视为表语从句）。
sentences.analysis_zh: 这句话信息密度很高，作者把「何时、与谁沟通」全部塞进句首状语，主句只剩 was clear 三个词，形成「状语长、主干短」的节奏，让读者视线最终落在 Eisenhower 的强硬态度上。翻译时中文宜按时间顺序先说沟通场景，再落到「明确表示」。注意 continued actions 是「持续（不停手）的行动」，暗含英法以并未因美国反对而收手。

sentences.en: This was the ability to easily finance debt at favourable interest rates because sterling played a central role in the international monetary system.
sentences.structure: 主干：This was the ability...；修饰：不定式 to easily finance debt 作 ability 的后置定语，at favourable interest rates 与 because sterling played... 分别表示方式条件与原因，原因状语从句修饰全句。
sentences.analysis_zh: This 回指上句的 exorbitant privilege，作者用一句「定义句」把抽象术语落地：特权就是「借债便宜又容易」。at favourable interest rates 译作「以有利的利率」，不要译成「优惠利率」（后者是专门的低息贷款概念）。because 从句点出机制——货币的国际地位，而不是军事实力，才是这项特权的根源，这正是下文拿英镑、美元作比的伏笔。

sentences.en: Just as the Suez crisis needs to be understood in the context of the cold war, the current conflict should also be seen through the lens of “cold war II” geopolitics.
sentences.structure: 主干：the current conflict should also be seen...；修饰：Just as 引导比较状语从句与主句呼应（Just as A..., B should also...）；through the lens of... 为方式状语；in the context of the cold war 为条件/背景状语。
sentences.analysis_zh: 典型的「类比收尾句」：作者用 Just as... also... 的框架把历史论证直接嫁接到当下议题上，全文的论证逻辑在此落定。through the lens of（透过……的透镜/视角）是外刊评论版高频隐喻，比 seeing... as 更有方法论意味。翻译时保留「透镜」的比喻，比译成「从……角度」更有力度。

background.title: 1956年苏伊士运河危机：一场被金融杠杆终结的军事行动
background.text_zh: 1956年7月，埃及总统纳赛尔宣布将苏伊士运河公司收归国有，以资助阿斯旺大坝建设。10月底，以色列、英国、法国出兵埃及，军事上迅速得手，政治上却全面崩盘：联合国大会通过决议要求停火，苏联威胁动用武力，而真正致命的一击来自美国——艾森豪威尔政府不仅在联合国施压，还抛售英镑、阻挠英国从国际货币基金组织获得紧急贷款，并威胁切断石油供应。英镑濒临崩溃，英国被迫在数周内撤军，艾登政府声望扫地。这场危机因此被视为「帝国终结」的标志性事件：它证明在布雷顿森林体系下，盟友的货币与信贷依赖足以抵消军事胜利。这也是本文把苏伊士与霍尔木兹相提并论的核心依据。

background.title: 霍尔木兹海峡、石油与「第二次冷战」
background.text_zh: 霍尔木兹海峡位于伊朗与阿曼之间，是波斯湾通往阿曼湾和印度洋的唯一海上出口，全球相当比例的海运石油与液化天然气须经此地，因此常被称为「世界油阀」。任何对这条水道的封锁或威胁，都会迅速传导为油价、运费与通胀问题——这正是文中说英国「未参战却受创」的原因。所谓「cold war II（第二次冷战）」，是近年评论界用来描述美中战略竞争的说法，其特征包括经济脱钩、技术管制、联盟体系重组以及通过第三方进行的代理人冲突。文中提到的「史诗之怒」行动，即文章设定的美以对伊朗军事打击，是作者展开全部类比的现实前提。

title_en: Detroit Could Block Billionaire-Owned Concrete Plant From Further Neighborhood Expansion
excerpt_en: The post Detroit Could Block Billionaire-Owned Concrete Plant From Further Neighborhood Expansion appeared first on ProPublica.
body_en: The Kronos concrete mixing plant overlooks the Cadillac Heights neighborhood in Detroit. Sarahbeth Maney/ProPublica After years of community opposition, Detroit city officials have taken steps to stop a concrete mixing facility from further expanding into a residential neighborhood.

City Council members, acting on a recommendation last week from planning officials, will soon consider a rezoning measure that would restrict industrial activity at the site of the Kronos concrete plant and surrounding area. The concrete facility at its current size could stay and continue to operate as normal.

The planning recommendation comes after a BridgeDetroit and ProPublica investigation this year revealed how city officials helped Crown Enterprises, a real estate company owned by Detroit’s wealthy Moroun family, obtain property in Cadillac Heights and then provided latitude when its Kronos facility violated environmental laws. Residents have been filing complaints and protesting Kronos for years, frustrated by the dust, noise and other issues created by the concrete operation.

Left in the Dust: How a Billionaire-Owned Concrete Plant Took Over a Detroit Community The City Planning Commission voted Oct. 22 to recommend a change to some of the zoning in the neighborhood from heavy to light industrial, which allows buildings such as warehouses but excludes facilities like concrete plants. The commission also recommended that other lots be zoned for residential and commercial purposes. Earlier this month, the commissioners unanimously voted to exclude industrial zoning in the area adjacent to Kronos, but they stepped back from that last week.

Sharon Buttry, who helped organize residents to protest against the Kronos plant, said she is glad the lots would be rezoned but was disappointed that the earlier recommendation, which was more pedestrian- and transit-friendly, didn’t stand.
Buttry said she fears that the latest zoning recommendation would make it easier for Crown to expand eventually. “We still want them to shut down or move,” she said.
The zoning plan was revisited at the request of City Planning Commissioner Fred Russell Jr., who said the adjustment would create a buffer between residents and the existing concrete plant.
The City Council, which will ultimately decide on the rezoning, has scheduled a public hearing for Nov. 19.

Over the last seven years, Crown has obtained dozens of parcels in Cadillac Heights — some through a land deal with the city in 2019 and others after residents sold their parcels and left. In all, the company now owns more than 160 lots in the neighborhood, most of which are barren.

How a 2019 Land-Swap Deal Accelerated the Morouns’ Foothold The Moroun family spent decades, from 1966 to 2018, records show, gradually acquiring lots in Cadillac Heights through their various companies, eventually putting the parcels all under the ownership of Crown Enterprises. A May 2019 deal with the city of Detroit allowed Crown to acquire dozens of additional parcels during the next seven years.

Note: Sale dates for 19 parcels could not be identified, but records show Crown owned them as of June. Sources: City of Detroit, Detroit’s Office of the Assessor, Wayne County Register of Deeds, Detroit City Council. Chris Alcantara/ProPublica In a letter to Detroit officials in mid-September and Oct. 22, a law firm representing Crown threatened legal action if city officials change the zoning, arguing that doing so would devalue the property and create uncertainty about future development.

Attorney Melvin Butch Hollowell also said if the rezoning goes through, the city would be backtracking on its commitment to support Crown’s development in Cadillac Heights. Crown obtained the land there in exchange for the company swapping property in another part of the city, which allowed automaker Stellantis to open the first new car plant in Detroit in three decades.

City officials have said they didn’t know Crown’s plans included a concrete facility. Crown did not present a specific plan at the time of the land transfer. But after the concrete plant opened, the city in 2022 signed a first-of-its-kind agreement with Crown that gave the company time to fix issues before being penalized. The agreement has allowed the company to avoid fines on several occasions, the news organizations have documented.

In response to questions from BridgeDetroit and ProPublica, a Crown spokesperson said the company has invested more than $10 million to develop the concrete operation based “on the City’s promises and actions of approving our plans for this facility.”
“The property was traded to us for the express purpose of redevelopment,” the spokesperson, Kenneth Dobson, wrote.

Dobson said that if the zoning changes, the company will not make the improvements it has promised, including new landscaping and sidewalks. He claimed the improvements would not be allowed under the new zoning and that they also wouldn’t be a sound business decision. City planning staff, however, said the company can still make the improvements.

The neighborhood surrounding Kronos has been zoned to allow heavy industry since the 1940s, when a rail line operated there. Before the concrete operation, the land was occupied by a trucking depot for decades.

Despite the zoning designation, the neighborhood attracted working-class families who lived in modest single-family houses. Buddy’s Pizza, famous as the birthplace of Detroit-style pizza, was founded there and drew crowds from across the city.

The City Planning Commission’s votes this month were four years in the making and part of a broader evaluation of land near the proposed Joe Louis Greenway, a walking and biking trail that will traverse the city and is already under construction.

enrich.title_zh: 底特律或将阻止亿万富翁旗下的混凝土搅拌站进一步向社区扩张
enrich.summary_zh: 底特律 Kronos 混凝土搅拌站多年引发粉尘、噪音投诉。BridgeDetroit 与 ProPublica 的调查披露，市政府曾帮助莫朗家族旗下的 Crown 公司拿下 Cadillac Heights 的地块，并在其违法后从宽处理。如今市规划委员会建议把该片区从重工业用地改为轻工业及住宅、商业用地，从而限制搅拌站继续扩张，但允许其现有规模继续运营；市议会将于 11 月 19 日举行听证会，而 Crown 已威胁采取法律行动。

paragraphs.en: The Kronos concrete mixing plant overlooks the Cadillac Heights neighborhood in Detroit. Sarahbeth Maney/ProPublica After years of community opposition, Detroit city officials have taken steps to stop a concrete mixing facility from further expanding into a residential neighborhood.
paragraphs.zh: Kronos 混凝土搅拌站俯瞰着底特律的 Cadillac Heights 社区。摄影：Sarahbeth Maney/ProPublica。在社区多年反对之后，底特律市政府官员已采取措施，阻止一家混凝土搅拌企业进一步向居民区扩张。

paragraphs.en: City Council members, acting on a recommendation last week from planning officials, will soon consider a rezoning measure that would restrict industrial activity at the site of the Kronos concrete plant and surrounding area. The concrete facility at its current size could stay and continue to operate as normal.
paragraphs.zh: 市议会议员根据规划部门官员上周提出的建议，即将审议一项重新区划的议案：该议案将限制 Kronos 混凝土搅拌站所在地及周边区域的工业活动。但该混凝土设施按现有规模可以保留，并照常运营。

paragraphs.en: The planning recommendation comes after a BridgeDetroit and ProPublica investigation this year revealed how city officials helped Crown Enterprises, a real estate company owned by Detroit’s wealthy Moroun family, obtain property in Cadillac Heights and then provided latitude when its Kronos facility violated environmental laws. Residents have been filing complaints and protesting Kronos for years, frustrated by the dust, noise and other issues created by the concrete operation.
paragraphs.zh: 这项规划建议出台之前，BridgeDetroit 与 ProPublica 今年的一项调查揭露：市政府官员曾帮助底特律富豪莫朗家族旗下的房地产公司 Crown Enterprises 在 Cadillac Heights 获得地产，而在其 Kronos 设施违反环保法规时，又对其予以宽容。多年来，居民不断投诉并抗议 Kronos，对混凝土生产带来的粉尘、噪音等问题深感不满。

paragraphs.en: Left in the Dust: How a Billionaire-Owned Concrete Plant Took Over a Detroit Community The City Planning Commission voted Oct. 22 to recommend a change to some of the zoning in the neighborhood from heavy to light industrial, which allows buildings such as warehouses but excludes facilities like concrete plants. The commission also recommended that other lots be zoned for residential and commercial purposes. Earlier this month, the commissioners unanimously voted to exclude industrial zoning in the area adjacent to Kronos, but they stepped back from that last week.
paragraphs.zh: 《被尘土抛下：一家亿万富翁拥有的混凝土搅拌站如何占领了底特律一个社区》（相关报道小标题）。市规划委员会于 10 月 22 日投票，建议将该社区部分地块的用地性质由重工业改为轻工业。轻工业用地允许建设仓库之类的建筑，但不包括混凝土搅拌站这类设施。委员会还建议把其他地块划为住宅和商业用途。本月早些时候，委员们曾一致投票决定在 Kronos 邻近区域取消工业用地性质，但上周又收回了这一做法。

paragraphs.en: Sharon Buttry, who helped organize residents to protest against the Kronos plant, said she is glad the lots would be rezoned but was disappointed that the earlier recommendation, which was more pedestrian- and transit-friendly, didn’t stand.
paragraphs.zh: 曾协助组织居民抗议 Kronos 搅拌站的莎伦·巴特里（Sharon Buttry）说，她乐见这些地块被重新区划，但对早先那份更有利于步行和公共交通的方案未能保留感到失望。

paragraphs.en: Buttry said she fears that the latest zoning recommendation would make it easier for Crown to expand eventually. “We still want them to shut down or move,” she said.
paragraphs.zh: 巴特里说，她担心最新的区划建议最终会让 Crown 更容易扩张。“我们仍然希望他们关停或搬走，”她说。

paragraphs.en: The zoning plan was revisited at the request of City Planning Commissioner Fred Russell Jr., who said the adjustment would create a buffer between residents and the existing concrete plant.
paragraphs.zh: 这份区划方案是应市规划委员会委员小弗雷德·拉塞尔（Fred Russell Jr.）的要求重新审议的。他表示，这一调整能在居民与现有混凝土搅拌站之间形成缓冲地带。

paragraphs.en: The City Council, which will ultimately decide on the rezoning, has scheduled a public hearing for Nov. 19.
paragraphs.zh: 重新区划最终将由市议会决定，市议会已将公开听证会定于 11 月 19 日举行。

paragraphs.en: Over the last seven years, Crown has obtained dozens of parcels in Cadillac Heights — some through a land deal with the city in 2019 and others after residents sold their parcels and left. In all, the company now owns more than 160 lots in the neighborhood, most of which are barren.
paragraphs.zh: 过去七年里，Crown 在 Cadillac Heights 拿下了数十块地：一部分来自 2019 年与市政府的一项土地交易，另一部分则是在居民出售地块离开后购入的。总体而言，该公司目前在该社区拥有 160 多块地，其中大部分仍是空地。

paragraphs.en: How a 2019 Land-Swap Deal Accelerated the Morouns’ Foothold The Moroun family spent decades, from 1966 to 2018, records show, gradually acquiring lots in Cadillac Heights through their various companies, eventually putting the parcels all under the ownership of Crown Enterprises. A May 2019 deal with the city of Detroit allowed Crown to acquire dozens of additional parcels during the next seven years.
paragraphs.zh: 《2019 年的一笔土地置换交易如何加速了莫朗家族的扎根》（相关报道小标题）。记录显示，从 1966 年到 2018 年，莫朗家族用了几十年时间，通过旗下多家公司逐步收购 Cadillac Heights 的地块，最终把这些地块全部归入 Crown Enterprises 名下。2019 年 5 月与底特律市达成的一项交易，则让 Crown 得以在此后七年内再获得数十块地。

paragraphs.en: Note: Sale dates for 19 parcels could not be identified, but records show Crown owned them as of June. Sources: City of Detroit, Detroit’s Office of the Assessor, Wayne County Register of Deeds, Detroit City Council. Chris Alcantara/ProPublica In a letter to Detroit officials in mid-September and Oct. 22, a law firm representing Crown threatened legal action if city officials change the zoning, arguing that doing so would devalue the property and create uncertainty about future development.
paragraphs.zh: 注：有 19 块地的出售日期无法确认，但记录显示截至今年 6 月 Crown 已拥有这些地块。数据来源：底特律市政府、底特律评估官办公室、韦恩县契约登记处、底特律市议会。制图：Chris Alcantara/ProPublica。在 9 月中旬和 10 月 22 日致底特律市官员的信中，代表 Crown 的律师事务所威胁称，如果市官员改变用地性质，将采取法律行动，理由是这样做会令房产贬值，并给未来开发带来不确定性。

paragraphs.en: Attorney Melvin Butch Hollowell also said if the rezoning goes through, the city would be backtracking on its commitment to support Crown’s development in Cadillac Heights. Crown obtained the land there in exchange for the company swapping property in another part of the city, which allowed automaker Stellantis to open the first new car plant in Detroit in three decades.
paragraphs.zh: 律师梅尔文·布奇·霍洛威尔（Melvin Butch Hollowell）还表示，如果重新区划获得通过，市政府就等于背弃了支持 Crown 在 Cadillac Heights 开发的承诺。Crown 获得当地土地，是以该公司交出城市另一处的土地作为交换；正是这笔置换让汽车制造商 Stellantis 得以在底特律开设三十年来首家新整车厂。

paragraphs.en: City officials have said they didn’t know Crown’s plans included a concrete facility. Crown did not present a specific plan at the time of the land transfer. But after the concrete plant opened, the city in 2022 signed a first-of-its-kind agreement with Crown that gave the company time to fix issues before being penalized. The agreement has allowed the company to avoid fines on several occasions, the news organizations have documented.
paragraphs.zh: 市官员表示，他们此前并不知道 Crown 的计划中包含混凝土设施。在土地转让时，Crown 并未提交具体方案。但在混凝土搅拌站开业后，市政府于 2022 年与 Crown 签署了一份史无前例的协议，给予该公司在受罚之前整改问题的时间。据这两家新闻机构记录，该协议已多次让该公司免于罚款。

paragraphs.en: In response to questions from BridgeDetroit and ProPublica, a Crown spokesperson said the company has invested more than $10 million to develop the concrete operation based “on the City’s promises and actions of approving our plans for this facility.”
paragraphs.zh: 在回应 BridgeDetroit 和 ProPublica 的提问时，Crown 的一位发言人表示，公司已投入超过 1000 万美元发展这一混凝土业务，依据是“市政府的承诺以及批准我们该设施相关计划的实际行动”。

paragraphs.en: “The property was traded to us for the express purpose of redevelopment,” the spokesperson, Kenneth Dobson, wrote.
paragraphs.zh: “这块地产交换给我们，明确目的就是进行再开发，”该发言人肯尼思·多布森（Kenneth Dobson）写道。

paragraphs.en: Dobson said that if the zoning changes, the company will not make the improvements it has promised, including new landscaping and sidewalks. He claimed the improvements would not be allowed under the new zoning and that they also wouldn’t be a sound business decision. City planning staff, however, said the company can still make the improvements.
paragraphs.zh: 多布森表示，如果用地性质改变，公司将不再进行此前承诺的改善工程，包括新增绿化景观和人行道。他声称，在新区划下这些改善工程不被允许，而且从商业角度看也不划算。但市规划部门的工作人员表示，该公司仍然可以进行这些改善工程。

paragraphs.en: The neighborhood surrounding Kronos has been zoned to allow heavy industry since the 1940s, when a rail line operated there. Before the concrete operation, the land was occupied by a trucking depot for decades.
paragraphs.zh: Kronos 周边社区自 20 世纪 40 年代起就被划为允许重工业的用地，当时那里有一条铁路线在运营。在混凝土业务进驻之前，这片土地曾长期被一家卡车运输场站占用。

paragraphs.en: Despite the zoning designation, the neighborhood attracted working-class families who lived in modest single-family houses. Buddy’s Pizza, famous as the birthplace of Detroit-style pizza, was founded there and drew crowds from across the city.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管用地性质如此，这一社区仍吸引了不少工薪家庭，他们住在朴素的独栋住宅里。以“底特律风格披萨”发源地而闻名的 Buddy’s Pizza 就创办于此，曾吸引全城食客慕名而来。

paragraphs.en: The City Planning Commission’s votes this month were four years in the making and part of a broader evaluation of land near the proposed Joe Louis Greenway, a walking and biking trail that will traverse the city and is already under construction.
